sections.heading: 2. Introduction
paragraphs: Welcome to Ecotwist Innovtions Private Limited. We're committed to protecting the privacy and security of your personal information. This Privacy Policy outlines how we collect, use, disclose, and protect the information you provide to us when you use our website, https://ecotwist.in, and our services. By accessing or using our website, you agree to the terms of this Privacy Policy.

subsections.heading: 3.1 Personal Information
points: Payment Information (processed securely via third-party gateways — not stored by us)

subsections.heading: 3.3 Cookies and Tracking Technologies
paragraphs: We use cookies, web beacons, and similar technologies to enhance your experience, analyze traffic, and personalize content. You can manage cookies through your browser settings, but disabling them may affect website functionality.

labelledPoints.label: To Provide Services:
labelledPoints.text: Process and fulfill orders, manage accounts, and deliver products.

labelledPoints.label: To Communicate:
labelledPoints.text: Send confirmations, updates, and transactional emails.

labelledPoints.label: To Improve Services:
labelledPoints.text: Analyze usage and customer preferences to enhance offerings.

labelledPoints.label: Security:
labelledPoints.text: Protect against fraud and unauthorized access.

labelledPoints.label: Service Providers:
labelledPoints.text: Third parties like payment gateways, shipping partners, analytics, and marketing vendors (strict confidentiality enforced).

labelledPoints.label: Legal Compliance:
labelledPoints.text: Disclosures when required by law or to protect rights and safety.

labelledPoints.label: Business Transfers:
labelledPoints.text: Data may transfer in case of merger, acquisition, or asset sale.

sections.heading: 6. Data Security
paragraphs: We use SSL encryption and secure storage measures to safeguard your data. While we strive for the highest level of security, no system can be guaranteed 100% secure.

labelledPoints.label: Access & Correction:
labelledPoints.text: Update personal details in account settings or request changes.

labelledPoints.label: Withdraw Consent:
labelledPoints.text: Contact us to withdraw consent, subject to legal restrictions.
